title: How plants grow
examples: What do seeds need to start growing?
Can a plant grow without sunshine?
What are the different parts of a plant?

explain.say: Today we learn how plants grow big and strong. A plant starts its life as a tiny seed. Seeds need the right things to wake up and grow.
Seeds need water to begin their journey. Water helps the little seed to swell up. You can see the seed starting to drink the water.
Light from the sun gives plants energy to live. Plants use light to make their own food. This process is very important for them to thrive.
The soil gives plants a safe home and nutrients. Soil holds the seed and gives it minerals. Roots grow down deep into the soil for support.
A plant has several parts that help it live. The roots stay underground and drink water. The stem holds the plant up tall and straight.

faq.q: Does the plant need air to grow?
faq.a: Yes, plants need air too. They take in a gas called carbon dioxide. This air helps them to make their food using sunlight.
asks: Do plants need air like us?

faq.q: Can plants grow in just water?
faq.a: No, plants need more than just water. They also need soil for support and minerals. The soil gives them what they need to stay healthy.
asks: What else besides water do plants need?

faq.q: What part makes the seeds for the next plant?
faq.a: The flower is usually the part that makes the seeds. After the flower fades, seeds develop inside it. These new seeds can start a new life.

faq.q: Do the roots grow in the air or in the ground?
faq.a: The roots always grow underground in the soil. They are like straws that drink water and nutrients from the earth. They help keep the plant steady.

faq.q: Does the stem do all the work for the plant?
faq.a: No, the stem only holds the plant up. The leaves do the important work of making food using sunlight and water. The stem just acts like a strong elevator.
asks: What is the job of the stem?

facts: Seeds are the beginning of a new plant life.
Plants use sunlight, water, and air to make food.
Roots anchor the plant in the soil.
Leaves are the main parts that capture sunlight.

quiz.say: A seed needs water, light, and what else to start growing?
quiz.why: Soil provides the physical home and necessary minerals for the seed to begin growing.

wrong.0: Light is needed, but it is not the only missing element.
wrong.1: The flower comes later; it is not needed for the start.
wrong.2: The stem is a part that grows up, not something needed at the start.

quiz.say: Which part of the plant usually grows underground?
quiz.why: Roots are the parts that grow down into the soil to absorb water and nutrients.

wrong.0: The stem is the main body that stands up above the soil.
wrong.1: Flowers are typically visible above the ground when they bloom.
wrong.3: Leaves are usually seen above the ground to catch sunlight.

quiz.say: If a plant has strong leaves, it can:
quiz.why: Leaves are where the plant traps sunlight to make the food it needs to live.

wrong.0: Making flowers is a later stage, not directly related to leaf strength.
wrong.2: Drinking water is mostly the job of the roots underground.
wrong.3: The stem grows, but the leaves are what create the energy for that growth.
